code: payload = fu_input_stream_read_bytes(stream, offset + hdrsz, payloadsz, error);
note: The uSWID header causes the parser to read attacker-controlled uncompressed coSWID bytes.

code: fw2 = fu_bytes_new_offset(payload, offset_tmp, payloadsz - offset_tmp, error);
note: Those bytes are passed as the next coSWID blob without changing attacker-selected CBOR types.
The input is decoded into a CBOR root map controlled by the file.
The root map pairs are obtained directly from the decoded attacker-controlled map.
The parser reads every map key as a uint8 without first checking that the CBOR key is an unsigned integer.
A non-uint CBOR key reaches libcbor's uint accessor and can cause the heap-buffer-overflow read reported by ASan.
